description:
One life. One shot.

Why die with the dream still in you?

I’d rather be called crazy than live average.
I’d rather be judged for trying than regret playing small.

People throw arrows at the ones in front.
They criticize what they don’t have the courage to do themselves.

Resistance doesn’t mean stop.
It usually means you’re leading.

You weren’t made to fit in.
You were made to build something real.

One life.
Go all in.
transcript: life. Just one. Why aren't we running like we're on fire towards our wildest dreams? We got one shot at this. Why aren't we like the crazy one? I want people to look at me like, that guy is nuts. Good. I got one shot at this life. I'd rather you call me crazy and a dreamer than a settler. You always know the leader by the arrows in their back, right? If people aren't talking or judging or thinking, then you're just kind of blending in. You're made to stand out.
spoken_hook_0_3s: Just one. Why aren't we running?
